issues.quote: Net income grew 18.7% to $94.2 billion in fiscal 2022 from $61.3 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2022 net income was $72.7 billion, not $94.2 billion. The stated 18.7% growth matches $72.7B; $94.2B would mean roughly 54% growth.

data.summary: Most figures are correct, but fiscal 2022 net income is misstated as $94.2B. The real figure is $72.7B, and that is the number that gives the stated 18.7% growth.
